title: gate-recipes
description: Every gate nornir builds, as the recipe generate_gates.py makes its crate from (gates/gate_recipes.toml). A gate is a generated variant: the read and write engines with its schema embedded and its format fixed to TOML. kind says which pattern; schema names the schemas_embedded constant; verify_paths says whether the paths the data names must exist (input and output gates only; a passthrough gate always verifies, a defaults gate never does).
